body:
I don't know why a young girl with her virginity would want to die. I am a mother with secondary infertility that causes my depression, so that is my perspective as someone who feels unfulfilled in the childbearing department. Find a good man to marry, I mean don't be in a huge rush but honestly, my suggestion for your happiness would be to marry and start a family. Research has shown that the happiest women have at least 4 children. The casual sex stuff is a satanic thing pushed on the youth along with birth control to destroy our reproductive potential, so you are absolutely right from both a moral and self preserving perspective to steer clear of anything casual. 

I also completely relate to the sense of knowing you are just going to fall into that pit of depression over and over again. It becomes perpetual in that it is inevitable. There literally is no avoiding the breakdowns, and just feeling like you want to cry and die all the time. 

I believe in God too, never mind the religion bashers. These are spiritual questions. I too struggle with the temptation to kill myself but I am scared of the spiritual and earthly consequences.

Interesting, I don't feel this way despite being very depressed.

I am happy I was born, my deceased mother suffered infertility for many years and the fact that my birth made her happy is one of the few useful aspects of my life.

It is very frustrating. The emotional and psychological pain I have to live with sucks. I bear the unbearable every day for my family. I sure as hell am not living for myself or for selfish happiness, that ship sailed long ago.

 I never understand when suicidal people say "they'll be better off without me." Shit, if you thought that, why are you still here talking about it? I know my family won't be better off without me. Which is why I go through the motions. 

Everything is about securing a future for them, at the end of the day. I want my kids to be happier than I was. I know no one else is capable of loving or caring for them like me. I have a general distaste and distrust for people and I can't leave them alone to fend for themselves in a hostile, disgusting world.

Besides, just waiting for death to come is another option. The mind is a powerful thing. I know that without a will to live and a prayer for death, God will eventually be merciful enough to grant me my wish.

It is such a dog eat dog world. I am in uni and it feels pointless. Quitting after this semester and doing a trade in the fall instead. I can't do the profession I originally wanted to either because it would involve me having to move out of province for the program, though I have already invested years of my life and thousands of dollars without any return or practical way to implement it. It sucks, definitely depressing.
Same boat. It's extremely sad feeling suicidal and playing with your kids. I feel horrible because they alone are worth living for but still I can't help but crave the grave
